title: Luke Meredith
text:
PhD Researcher in Mathematics at the University of Warwick.
My research focuses on stochastic interacting systems, Markov chains, opinion dynamics and social learning.

title: Luke Meredith
text:
Research interests

Markov chains and mixing times
Interacting particle systems
Opinion dynamics
Mean-field stochastic systems
Multi-agent learning
Stochastic multi-armed bandits

title: Luke Meredith
text:
Current research
I am currently interested in the relationship between microscopic stochastic dynamics and macroscopic behaviour, particularly phase transitions, metastability and critical slowing.
